reports.title: Devin per-turn assignment/chat authentication recovery
reports.scope_trigger: Router models may reject cached credentials during AssignModel before GetChatMessage; non-router-only cache probes cannot establish this boundary.
contracts: One two-attempt loop owns assignment and chat together, not one loop per operation.
Either operation's 401/403 invalidates the cache key (apiKey, original baseUrl), including the final rejection; invalidation advances the existing cache write epoch.
Only the first rejection permits one forced auth refresh and reconstruction of assignment/chat using returned credentials and custom server URL.
Assignment failures outside 401/403, including malformed responses and transport failures, terminate without retry or chat fallback.
A router UID is never substituted for failed assignment. Assignment/cascade identity is retained; existing target metadata wire shapes stay unchanged.

error_matrix.first_assignment_401_or_403: Invalidate; refresh once; repeat assignment and then chat if assignment succeeds.
error_matrix.second_assignment_401_or_403: Invalidate; terminal error; no third attempt and no chat.
error_matrix.first_chat_401_then_second_assignment_40: Final assignment invalidates and terminates, demonstrating a shared rather than independent retry budget.
error_matrix.assignment_non_auth_failure: Terminal; zero additional refreshes, assignments or chat requests.
error_matrix.late_old_auth_completion: Existing epoch guard prevents its cache write from replacing a newer refresh or invalidation.

cases.good: Cached credentials rejected by assignment; refreshed credentials produce a valid assignment and one successful chat.
cases.base: Cached credentials accepted; no extra GetUserJwt on another turn.
cases.bad: Assignment runs outside recovery and poisons subsequent turns until JWT expiry; or assignment receives its own additional retry budget.
